outcomes.outcome: smtpd listens on the configured port, greets with the configured host name and presents the site's certificate over STARTTLS
the configured SASL users authenticate through dovecot, and the client-access map lists the allowed IPs

a listed client, logged in, may send from an address in the general list that it owns (both users, each from its own address); refused are an address outside the general list, an address owned by another user, a client that is not logged in, a wrong password (535) and a client address that is not listed
a message submitted by a logged-in user from its own address is queued (250 Ok queued) and, for a local recipient, delivered to the mailbox

a logged-in user's message to a non-local domain is relayed (accepted at RCPT under smtpd_relay_restrictions) and delivered by postfix's SMTP client straight to the recipient's host (relayhost empty), here an address-literal recipient on the peer, whose sink receives it
a recipient domain resolved through its MX (a DNS lookup for the domain's mail exchanger)

uncovered.why: the relay is exercised with an address-literal recipient, which skips the MX lookup; the lab's DNS serves no MX for a fixture domain
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: a lab DNS zone with an MX record for a fixture domain pointing at a peer
uncovered.evidence: relayed-to-another-domain sends to p8test-rcpt@[peer address]; the node's resolvers (NAT DNS) serve no fixture zone

outcomes.outcome: TLS is mandatory (no AUTH offered and MAIL FROM and AUTH refused before STARTTLS)
system accounts cannot authenticate (dovecot's passdb is the passwd-file only; an OS account whose password the OS accepts gets 535)
on outgoing delivery, a From header that matches none of do_not_warn_from_addresses_regexes is logged as a warning (and still delivered); one that matches is not
the extra_sec hardening (protocols, ciphers, a generated DH group) and Let's Encrypt-shaped certificate names

uncovered.why: the fixture sets extra_sec and letsencrypt_certificate false; one set holds one params fixture
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: more than one params fixture per set
uncovered.evidence: the params fixture: extra_sec false, letsencrypt_certificate false; phase3.py runs a set with one fixture
